title: runtime/mutation
description: MutationProposal contract (feature 016; FR-1405): the typed output a rimbrain.improve model must emit when reflecting on goal failure / near-failure evidence. Mutations apply to a candidate pack via the packmut ops engine; malformed output is a named error, never a guess. The proposal carries no execution authority — the deterministic gate decides.

mutation_id.description: id grammar (common/id) with the mut. prefix.

base_revision.description: sha256 canonical hash of the pack the mutations were built against; mismatch = stale proposal, rejected.

failure_paths.description: Failure paths that triggered: which goals/steps failed and the inferred mechanism.

likely_paths.description: Failure paths that look likely next run given the evidence.

analysis.description: The model's failure analysis — recorded for diagnosis, never executed.

op.description: set: write dict key at path; append: push value onto list at path; remove: drop addressed element/key; upsert: replace list element whose id == value.id, else append.

path.description: Dotted pack path; a segment matching a list element's 'id' descends into it (e.g. govern.goals.maintain-storage.retry_polls).

value.description: Required for set/append/upsert; upsert values must carry 'id'. Forbidden for remove.

mutations.description: Bounded mutation set — one best change-set per pass.

rationale.description: Model's stated reasoning; recorded, never executed.
